negatives.claim: Self-supervised DNA pretraining followed by functional supervision improves a bacterial promoter generator (AlphaGenome-discussion proposal #12)
negatives.scope: GENERator-1.2B-prokaryote ONLY, at DEFAULT sampling, ZERO-SHOT with NO fine-tuning, scored by distinguishability against a 3-mer Markov chain on E. coli promoter windows. This is STAGE 1 of a 3-stage recipe used ALONE; stages 2-3 (functional + perturbational supervision) were never run.
negatives.revival_condition: any fine-tuned checkpoint of a prokaryote DNA LM scored on the same distinguishability falsifier -- which IS family G-D, already planned

negatives.claim: A learned multi-resolution sequence encoder beats fixed features on genomic promoter sequence (AlphaGenome-discussion proposal #1)
negatives.scope: A 13,217-parameter conv at THREE kernel widths (6/20/75) over 150 bp peak tiles -- ~1 decade of range. The proposal specifies 1 bp/16 bp/128 bp/1 kb/10 kb over 1 Mb (FOUR decades), which a 150 bp tile cannot host at all, so the proposed arm is UNRUNNABLE on this substrate rather than merely unrun.
negatives.revival_condition: the 4-decade pyramid is run on a substrate with >=3 decades of available range (a longer genomic window, or a constructed eukaryotic/human panel)

negatives.claim: Modelling variant COMBINATIONS (epistasis) beats an additive model (AlphaGenome-discussion proposal #11)
negatives.scope: HIV-1 RT ONLY, Stanford PhenoSense fold-change labels, 4 drugs, leave-one-study-out, pairwise + non-linear estimators vs a linear one-hot model. One virus, one protein family, one label type, clinical-isolate CO-OCCURRENCE rather than constructed combinations.
negatives.revival_condition: an epistasis model tested on a CONSTRUCTED multi-variant panel (combinatorial mutagenesis) rather than on co-occurrence in natural isolates
